WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-12')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-12')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328','MPR1000200','MPAR100041')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

select TRIM(mp.model_portfolio_id) AS ACCOUNT, ss.abor_security_name_id AS SECURITY_NAME_ID, TRIM(max(ss.abor_security_id)) AS SECURITY_ID,
    TRIM(asi.isin) AS ISIN, concat(shm.abor_maturity_date, ' 00:00:00.000') AS MATURITY_DATE, 
    TRIM(regexp_replace(ss.abor_security_group_id, '(\w)(\w*)', x -> upper(x[1]) || lower(x[2]))) AS SECURITY_GROUP_ID, 
    MAX(shm.balance_nominal_number) / 1000 AS POSITION, SUM(0) / 1000 AS REPOPOSITION, 
    TRIM(asi.cusip) AS CUSIP, TRIM(asi.isin) AS ISIN, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP as LAST_UPDATE_TIME 
    from reference.scd_securities ss
    join  holdings.scd_holdings_main shm on shm.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number and ss.business_date = shm.business_date 
	left join asset.asset_security_identifiers asi on asi.cppib_sec_id = cast(shm.cppib_sec_id as int) and ss.business_date=cast(asi.business_date as varchar)
	join reference.scd_model_portfolio mp on mp.model_portfolio_id = shm.model_portfolio_id
    where mp.business_date = shm.business_date and shm.business_date = '2025-06-18'  
    AND ( mp.model_portfolio_id IN ('CICOCS','CIPCDMS','CIPCEMS','CREA','IPCCMGCRD2','IPCFITS','IPCMTNS','PMICMGCRD2','PMISHHGC','REFCMCNB','REFCMCNMB','REFCMFSB','RITORRE1','SHACRSS') ) 
    AND shm.abor_security_type_id  IN ('GOVMKT', 'REPO', 'REVREPO', 'NONMKT')
    AND NOT (
			shm.balance_nominal_number_unsettled = 0 
			and shm.balance_nominal_number = 0 
			and shm.clean_value_quotation_currency = 0
			and shm.accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency = 0
			and shm.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency = 0
			and shm.next_dividend_quotation_currency = 0
			and shm.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency = 0)
	and (mp.investment_department_sub_group_responsibility_code not in ('EPM')
	or mp.model_portfolio_id in ('EPMHCRS','EPMCVSL','EPMDSPA','EPMFTPC','EPMMYAT','EPMNKTF','EPMBNPN','EPMSERK','EPMCVG2','EPMDSPI','EPMFTLB','EPMNKTD','EPMCVLD','EPMCVLG','EPMCVLR'))
    GROUP BY mp.model_portfolio_id, ss.abor_security_name_id, asi.isin , shm.abor_maturity_date, ss.abor_security_group_id,asi.cusip
    HAVING (ss.abor_security_group_id = 'BOND' AND ABS(SUM(shm.balance_nominal_number)) >= 1)
    OR (ss.abor_security_group_id = 'Security Lending' AND shm.abor_maturity_date > '2025-06-18') 
    ORDER BY ss.abor_security_group_id, mp.model_portfolio_id, ss.abor_security_name_id, shm.abor_maturity_date

with old_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_dev"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'N'
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
new_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_dev"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_breached_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_breach_date as (
    select *
    from old_breached_records
    union all
    select *
    from new_breached_records
),
old_alert_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_alert_date
    from "risk_dev"."limit_utilization"
    where is_alert = 'N'
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
new_alert_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_alert_date
    from "risk_dev"."limit_utilization"
    where is_alert = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_alert_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_alert_date as (
    select *
    from old_alert_records
    union all
    select *
    from new_alert_records
)

with holdings as (

                        select 
                        business_date,
                        quotation_currency_code,
                        model_portfolio_id,
                        abor_security_id,
                        sum(COALESCE(clean_value_portfolio_currency, 0)) as clean_value_portfolio_currency,
                        sum(COALESCE(dirty_value_portfolio_currency,0)) - sum(COALESCE(clean_value_portfolio_currency, 0)) as accrued_interest_end_of_period_portfolio_currency,

                        sum(COALESCE(clean_value_quotation_currency, 0)) as clean_value_quotation_currency,
                        sum(COALESCE(dirty_value_quotation_currency,0)) - sum(COALESCE(clean_value_quotation_currency, 0)) as accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency

                        from holdings.scd_holdings_main
                        where business_date >= '2025-03-31' and business_date <= '2025-06-18'
                        group by business_date, quotation_currency_code, model_portfolio_id, abor_security_id
                   
                    ), pnl as (
                    
                        select 
                            psl.business_date, --key
                            psl.aggregation_level_1 as model_portfolio_id, --key
                            psl.aggregation_level_2 as currency, --key
                            psl.aggregation_level_3 as abor_security_id, --key 

                            s.scd_security_key_id as abor_security_key_id,
                            s.cppib_sec_id, 		
                            
                            psl.aggregation_level_3_long_name as abor_security_name,
                            isi.level_2_nodename as "department",
                            isi.level_3_nodename as "signal",
                            isi.level_4_nodename as "invgroup",	

                            s.reporting_id_name,
                            s.abor_instrument_type_id, 
                            s.abor_security_group_name, 		
                            s.abor_security_type_name,
                                
                            case
                                WHEN s.country_of_exposure_code is not null then s.country_of_exposure_code
                                else s.abor_country_id
                            end as conutry_id,
                            
                            s.abor_quote_type, 
                            s.abor_quote_factor,
                                
                            --PC == reporting_currency == CAD
                            --QC == quotation_currency == Local
                            
                            LAG(psl.balance_nominal_number) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) as balance_start,
                            psl.balance_nominal_number as balance_end,
                                    
                            LAG(psl.clean_price) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) as cleanpx_start,
                            psl.clean_price as cleanpx_end,
                            
                            LAG(psl.dirty_price) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) as dirtypx_start,
                            psl.dirty_price as dirtypx_end,	
                            
                            LAG(psl.market_value_quotation_currency) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) as mtm_start_local, 
                            psl.market_value_quotation_currency as mtm_end_local,

                            psl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency as net_cash_local,
                            psl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency as pnl_local,
                           
                            LAG(psl.market_value_reporting_currency) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) as mtm_start_cad, 
                            psl.market_value_reporting_currency as mtm_end_cad,
                            
                            psl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency as net_cash_cad,
                            psl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency as pnl_cad,

                            CASE 
                                WHEN LAG(psl.fx_rate_quotation_currency_portfolio_currency) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) IS NULL THEN 0
                                ELSE LAG(psl.fx_rate_quotation_currency_portfolio_currency) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date)
                            END as fx_start,

                            CASE 
                                WHEN psl.fx_rate_quotation_currency_portfolio_currency IS NULL THEN 0
                                ELSE psl.fx_rate_quotation_currency_portfolio_currency
                            END as fx_end,

                            LAG(mh.clean_value_quotation_currency) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) as cleanval_start_source,
                            mh.clean_value_quotation_currency as cleanval_end_source,

                            LAG(mh.accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) as accrual_start_source,
                            mh.accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency as accrual_end_source,
                                
                            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 ORDER BY psl.business_date) AS row_num 
                            
                        from performance.scd_performance_seclvl psl

                        left join holdings mh on mh.abor_security_id = psl.aggregation_level_3 and mh.model_portfolio_id = psl.aggregation_level_1 and mh.quotation_currency_code = psl.aggregation_level_2 and mh.business_date = psl.business_date
                        left join reference.scd_securities s on s.abor_security_id = psl.aggregation_level_3 and s.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities) --current pnl date
                        left join finance_accounting.v_investment_structure isi on psl.aggregation_level_1 = isi.id_model_portfolio  and isi.business_date = (select max(business_date) FROM finance_accounting.v_investment_structure) --current pnl date
                        where isi.level_2_nodename = 'Credit Investments' and psl.business_date >= '2025-03-31' and psl.business_date <= '2025-06-18' --previous pnl date TO GET the lag values
                )

                select *
                from pnl
                where business_date >= '2025-04-01' and business_date <= '2025-06-18' --ONLY pick up the CURRENT pnl date rows

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 19
		AND hour between 13 and 14
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-19 13:10:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 19
		AND hour between 22 and 23
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-19 22:46:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::abc3339025e0a3ce5cb5fe639a738850c5a0868b62be9b4828751bcde55c86d4 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 19
		AND hour between 02 and 03
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-19 02:18:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

  staging.source,

  staging.run_id,
  staging.extract_timestamp,
  staging.extract_timestamp_iso_8601,
  staging.extract_timestamp_time_zone,
  --------------------------------------
  -- identifiers
  --------------------------------------
  staging.account_id,
  reference.scd_id,
  reference.security_identifier,
  reference.issuer_identifier,
  reference.cppib_security_id,
  reference.cppib_entity_id,
  staging.source_data_id,

  reference.sentry_issuer_id,
  reference.model_portfolio_code,
  reference.deal_id,
  reference.upstream_pipeline_number,

  reference.project_name,

  reference.country_of_exposure,
  reference.private_vs_public,

  reference.seniority,
  reference.risk_rating,
  reference.investment_department_id,
  reference.investment_status,
  reference.investment_lifecycle,
  reference.sector,
  reference.maturity_date AS maturity_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- other staging
  --------------------------------------
  COALESCE(staging.funding_currency, staging.deal_currency) AS funding_currency, 
  CASE
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm >= 0 THEN 'Deployment'
    ELSE 'Disposition'
  END AS deployment_disposition,
  COALESCE(staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm, 0) * (COALESCE(staging.probability_of_close, 0) / 100.0) AS probability_weighted_investment_amount_local,
  staging.funded_amount,
  staging.quantity_net,
  staging.market_value,
  staging.portfolio_name,
  staging.sentry_security_type,
  staging.price_multiplier,
  staging.quantity_multiplier,
  staging.debt_factor,
  staging.model_portfolio_id,
  staging.ticket_number,
  --------------------------------------
  -- fixed-values specified in BRD
  --------------------------------------
  staging.probability_of_close AS probability_of_close,
  'Binding' AS binding,
  'Net Purchases and Sales' AS capital_usage_component,
  'Investment Funding/Distribution' AS transaction_cash_flow_type,
  'Y' AS send_to_treasury_y_n,
  --------------------------------------
  -- 'expected'-related fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.expected_funding_date,
  staging.expected_trade_date,
  staging.expected_exit_price,
  staging.expected_exit_probability,
  staging.expected_exit_date,
  (COALESCE(staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm, 0) * -1) AS expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm,
  --------------------------------------
  -- will be calculated by python code
  --------------------------------------
  NULL AS unadjusted_exit_projection,
  --------------------------------------
  -- created by and updated by fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.last_updated_by,
  staging.last_updated_date,
  staging.created_by_user_group,
  staging.created_by,
  staging.date_updated,
  --------------------------------------
  -- source business dates
  --------------------------------------
  staging.business_date AS staging_src_business_date,
  reference.business_date AS reference_src_business_date,
  staging.sentry_transactions_src_business_date,
  staging.sentry_security_src_business_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- comment and error
  --------------------------------------
  staging.comment,
  staging.error,
  --------------------------------------
  -- NULL on purpose (from requirements)
  --------------------------------------
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount,
  NULL AS fo_comments,
  NULL AS pec_recusals,
  NULL AS pec_pipeline_y_n,
  NULL AS fx_spot,
  NULL AS full_amt_cad_mm,
  NULL AS rejected_deals_reason,
  --------------------------------------
  -- investigate these
  --------------------------------------
  -- staging.investment_program
  -- reference.investment_strategy
  -- reference.investment_group
  -- staging.tfm_inv_sub_strategy
  --------------------------------------
  -- helpful debug information
  --------------------------------------
  staging.transaction_code AS transaction_code,
  'ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_unsettled_transactions_staging, ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference' AS data_sources_list,
  'n' AS ignore_y_n
  --------------------------------------
FROM
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_unsettled_transactions_staging staging
LEFT JOIN
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference reference
ON
  staging.security_identifier = reference.security_identifier and staging.run_id = reference.run_id
WHERE
  staging.run_id = '8a21d570-7745-4efb-8187-f0abee390075'

SELECT
  --------------------------------------
  -- metadata
  --------------------------------------
  staging.source,
  staging.business_date,
  staging.run_id,
  staging.extract_timestamp,
  staging.extract_timestamp_iso_8601,
  staging.extract_timestamp_time_zone,
  --------------------------------------
  -- identifiers
  --------------------------------------
  staging.account_id,
  reference.scd_id,
  reference.security_identifier,
  reference.issuer_identifier,
  reference.cppib_security_id,
  reference.cppib_entity_id,
  staging.source_data_id,
  reference.sentry_security_id,
  reference.sentry_issuer_id,
  reference.model_portfolio_code,
  reference.deal_id,
  reference.upstream_pipeline_number,
  --------------------------------------
  -- other reference
  --------------------------------------
  reference.security_name,
  reference.strategy,
  reference.sub_strategy,
  reference.project_name,
  reference.investment_name,
  reference.country_of_exposure,
  reference.private_vs_public,
  reference.asset_category,
  reference.seniority,
  reference.risk_rating,
  reference.investment_department_id,
  reference.investment_status,
  reference.investment_lifecycle,
  reference.sector,
  reference.maturity_date AS maturity_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- other staging
  --------------------------------------
  COALESCE(staging.funding_currency, staging.deal_currency) AS funding_currency, 
  CASE
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm >= 0 THEN 'Deployment'
    ELSE 'Disposition'
  END AS deployment_disposition,
  COALESCE(staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm, 0) * (COALESCE(staging.probability_of_close, 0) / 100.0) AS probability_weighted_investment_amount_local,
  staging.funded_amount,
  staging.quantity_net,
  staging.market_value,
  staging.portfolio_name,
  staging.sentry_security_type,
  staging.price_multiplier,
  staging.quantity_multiplier,
  staging.debt_factor,
  staging.model_portfolio_id,
  staging.ticket_number,
  --------------------------------------
  -- fixed-values specified in BRD
  --------------------------------------
  staging.probability_of_close AS probability_of_close,
  'Binding' AS binding,
  'Net Purchases and Sales' AS capital_usage_component,
  'Investment Funding/Distribution' AS transaction_cash_flow_type,
  'Y' AS send_to_treasury_y_n,
  --------------------------------------
  -- 'expected'-related fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.expected_funding_date,
  staging.expected_trade_date,
  staging.expected_exit_price,
  staging.expected_exit_probability,
  staging.expected_exit_date,
  (COALESCE(staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm, 0) * -1) AS expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm,
  --------------------------------------
  -- will be calculated by python code
  --------------------------------------
  NULL AS unadjusted_exit_projection,
  --------------------------------------
  -- created by and updated by fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.last_updated_by,
  staging.last_updated_date,
  staging.created_by_user_group,
  staging.created_by,
  staging.date_updated,
  --------------------------------------
  -- source business dates
  --------------------------------------
  staging.business_date AS staging_src_business_date,
  reference.business_date AS reference_src_business_date,
  staging.sentry_transactions_src_business_date,
  staging.sentry_security_src_business_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- comment and error
  --------------------------------------
  staging.comment,
  staging.error,
  --------------------------------------
  -- NULL on purpose (from requirements)
  --------------------------------------
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount,
  NULL AS fo_comments,
  NULL AS pec_recusals,
  NULL AS pec_pipeline_y_n,
  NULL AS fx_spot,
  NULL AS full_amt_cad_mm,
  NULL AS rejected_deals_reason,
  --------------------------------------
  -- investigate these
  --------------------------------------
  -- staging.investment_program
  -- reference.investment_strategy
  -- reference.investment_group
  -- staging.tfm_inv_sub_strategy
  --------------------------------------
  -- helpful debug information
  --------------------------------------
  staging.transaction_code AS transaction_code,
  'ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_unsettled_transactions_staging, ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference' AS data_sources_list,
  'n' AS ignore_y_n
  --------------------------------------
FROM
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_unsettled_transactions_staging staging
LEFT JOIN
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference reference
ON
  staging.security_identifier = reference.security_identifier and staging.run_id = reference.run_id
WHERE
  staging.run_id = '8a21d570-7745-4efb-8187-f0abee390075'

            DATE('2025-06-10')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-10')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')

                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT

/* QuickSight e99b1af3-1be1-4ea5-927b-9e6443dae512 */
SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name

		, split_level

			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'

		, case

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD

			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id

				, node_name

					and "level" = 0

			/* perf_top_down_monthly:

			union all
			select

				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc

				performance.perf_top_down_monthly

		on

			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where

				(

				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */

					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'

		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y

	select

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd

			select

				, "level"

				, pnl_4yp_rc

				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )

				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )

			/* perf_top_down_monthly:

		from

			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'

		/* VALUE */

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level"

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc

				or (

	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[

			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'

			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'

			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'

			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'

			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'

		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency

			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )

	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y

			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency

			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 19
		AND hour between 09 and 10
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-19 09:58:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

WITH statestreet_identifiers AS (
    SELECT
        ss.asset_id as asset_id,
        ss.sedol AS ss_sedol,
        ss.isin AS ss_isin,
        COALESCE(si1.cppib_sec_id, si2.cppib_sec_id, si3.cppib_sec_id) AS cppib_sec_id,
        COALESCE(si1.cusip, si2.cusip, si3.cusip, ss.asset_id) AS cusip, -- Defaults to asset_id
        COALESCE(si1.sedol, si2.sedol, si3.sedol) AS si_sedol,
        COALESCE(si1.isin, si2.isin, si3.isin) AS si_isin,
        COALESCE(si1.bloomberg_unique_id, si2.bloomberg_unique_id, si3.bloomberg_unique_id) AS bloomberg_unique_id,
        COALESCE(si1.sec_typ_lvl1_nm, si2.sec_typ_lvl1_nm, si3.sec_typ_lvl1_nm) AS sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        COALESCE(si1.sec_nm, si2.sec_nm, si3.sec_nm) AS securityName,
        ss.bus_date
    FROM asset.statestreet_custody_security_identifiers ss
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers_universe si1
        ON ss.sedol = si1.sedol
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers_universe si2
        ON ss.asset_id = si2.cusip
        AND ss.sedol <> si1.sedol -- Only join on CUSIP if SEDOL didn't match
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers_universe si3
        ON ss.isin = si3.isin
        AND ss.sedol <> si1.sedol
        AND ss.asset_id <> si2.cusip -- Only join on ISIN if neither SEDOL nor CUSIP matched
    WHERE ss.bus_date = date_parse('2025-06-18', '%Y-%m-%d')
        AND COALESCE(si1.bloomberg_unique_id, si2.bloomberg_unique_id, si3.bloomberg_unique_id) IS NOT NULL
        AND si1.del_dt IS NULL
        AND si2.del_dt IS NULL
        AND si3.del_dt IS NULL
),

equities AS (
    SELECT
        aeu.bloomberg_primary_listing_exchange_flag,
        equity.*
    FROM statestreet_identifiers equity
    JOIN asset.asset_equity_universe aeu
        ON equity.cppib_sec_id = aeu.cppib_sec_id
    WHERE aeu.bloomberg_primary_listing_exchange_flag = 'Y'
),

bonds AS (
    SELECT
        '' AS bloomberg_primary_listing_exchange_flag,
        bond.*
    FROM statestreet_identifiers bond
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (

    )
),

    SELECT * FROM equities
    UNION
    SELECT * FROM bonds
),

        invest_type_cd AS security_type_code
    FROM df_trusted_prod.statestreet_custody_holdings
    WHERE bus_date = date_parse('2025-06-18', '%Y-%m-%d')
),

    SELECT
        t.cppib_sec_id,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Bond' THEN ab.bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Equity' THEN ae.bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange

            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Equity' THEN ae.issue_country_iso
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Money market' THEN amm.issue_country_iso
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Entitlement' THEN aw.issue_country_iso
            ELSE NULL

            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Bond' THEN ab.trade_currency_code
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Equity' THEN ae.trade_currency_code
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Money market' THEN amm.trade_currency_code
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Entitlement' THEN aw.trade_currency_code
            ELSE NULL
        END AS trading_currency
    FROM identifiers t
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_bond_universe ab
        ON t.cppib_sec_id = ab.cppib_sec_id
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_equity_universe ae
        ON t.cppib_sec_id = ae.cppib_sec_id
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_money_market amm
        ON t.cppib_sec_id = amm.cppib_sec_id
        AND amm.business_date = date_parse('2025-06-18', '%Y-%m-%d')

"business_transaction_code", "settlement_currency", "trade_date", "payment_date", "nominal", "nominal_basis", "elementary_transaction_code", "interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency", "interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency", "transaction_cancellation_flag", "reconciliation_status", "created_date", "party_id", "epm_party_name", "transaction_number_in_originating_system", "payment_amount_quotation_currency", "payment_amount_portfolio_currency", "external_short_tag", "settlement_date", "quotation_currency", "number_of_units", "cross_deal_indicator", "settlement_location", "esm_country_code", "country_ref_code", "esm_country_name", "esm_incorp_country_name", "portfolio_group_id", "abor_security_group_name", "abor_security_type_name", "model_portfolio_name", "country_ref_name", "quotation_currency_name", "price_qc", "price_pc", "fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency", "cppib_country_of_exposure_name", "cppib_currency_of_exposure_name", "portfolio_name", "portfolio_group_name", "investment_strategy_name", "investment_department_name", "abor_instrument_type_id", "investment_type_name", "investmentstructurelevel3", "investmentstructurelevel4", "abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency", "other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency", "abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency", "other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency", "portfolio_id", "ibor_reason", "abor_coupon_rate", "dividend_per_share", "borrowing_account", "coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency", "coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency", "coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency", "restitution_expected_portfolio_currency", "restitution_expected_quotation_currency", "restitution_expected_settlement_currency", "accrued_interest_portfolio_currency", "accrued_interest_quotation_currency", "current_value_portfolio_currency", "current_value_quotation_currency", "additional_payable_amount_portfolio_currency", "additional_payable_amount_quotation_currency"
FROM (WITH RankedTransactions AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
						order by
							changed_date desc -- change date is actual loaded date so use this to get the latest data.
           ) AS rn
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    WHERE accounting_framework_id = 'PCLFWKMAIN'
),
JoinedData AS (
    SELECT 
        st.scd_transaction_number_primary_key,
        CAST(st.business_date AS DATE) AS business_date,
        ROUND(st.abor_transaction_number) AS abor_transaction_number,
        st.abor_security_id,
        st.abor_security_number,
        st.abor_security_name,
        st.model_portfolio_id,
        st.portfolio_id,
        st.business_transaction_code,
        st.settlement_currency,
        CAST(st.trade_date AS DATE) AS trade_date,
        CAST(st.payment_date AS DATE) AS payment_date,
        st.nominal,
        st.nominal_basis,
        st.elementary_transaction_code,
        st.interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency,
        st.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,
        st.transaction_cancellation_flag,
        st.reconciliation_status,
        CAST(CAST(st.created_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS created_date,
        st.transaction_number_in_originating_system,
        st.payment_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
        st.external_short_tag,
        CAST(st.settlement_date AS DATE) AS settlement_date,
        st.settlement_location,
        st.quotation_currency,
        st.number_of_units,
        st.price AS price_qc,
        st.price * st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS price_pc,
        st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
        st.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency,
        st.accrued_interest_quotation_currency,
        st.current_value_portfolio_currency,
        st.current_value_quotation_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_portfolio_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.ibor_reason,
        st.dividend_per_share,
        st.borrowing_account,
        st.rn,
        CASE 
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') AND st.abor_security_name LIKE '%CAD%' THEN 'Y'
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') THEN 'N'
        END AS cross_deal_indicator,
        -- From joins
        es.sedol,
        es.isin,
        es.cusip,
        es.esm_incorp_country_code,
        es.security_name_id,
        es.esm_country_code,
        es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
        es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,
        smp.sst_custody_account_code,
        smp.model_portfolio_name,
        smp.investment_strategy_name,
        smp.investment_department_name,
        ep.party_id,
        ep.epm_party_name,
        ss.abor_security_group_name,
        ss.abor_security_type_name,
        ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
        ss.investment_type_name,
        ss.abor_coupon_rate,
        rec.country_ref_code,
        rcc_exchange_country.country_name AS esm_country_name,
        rcc_incorp_country.country_name AS esm_incorp_country_name,
        sp.portfolio_group_id,
        sp.portfolio_name,
        sp.portfolio_group_name,
        rcc_trade_country.country_name AS country_ref_name,
        rcc.currency_name AS quotation_currency_name,
        stc.abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
        stc.other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
        stc.abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
        stc.other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
        spif.investmentstructurelevel3,
        spif.investmentstructurelevel4
    FROM RankedTransactions st
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM asset.enterprise_security
    ) es ON st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id AND es.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp 
        ON smp.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)
        AND st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd_party_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM party.enterprise_party
    ) ep ON st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id AND ep.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities ss 
        ON st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
        AND ss.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_exchange_codes rec 
        ON es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
        AND coalesce(es.mic, 'null') = coalesce(rec.mic, 'null')
        AND es.esm_exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'
        AND rec.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country 
        ON es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
        AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country 
        ON es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
        AND rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS latest
        FROM reference.scd_portfolio
    ) sp ON sp.latest = 1 AND sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country 
        ON rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
        AND rcc_trade_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT *,
		    ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY abor_transaction_number ORDER BY business_date DESC ) AS latest
		FROM (
			SELECT abor_transaction_number,
				business_date,
				transaction_cancellation_flag,
				trade_date,
				MAX(abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency) abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Cost' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
				MAX(abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency) abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Cost' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) restitution_expected_settlement_currency
		 	FROM trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
		 	GROUP BY abor_transaction_number,
		    	business_date,
		    	transaction_cancellation_flag,
		    	trade_date
		    )
    ) stc
        ON stc.latest = 1
        AND stc.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        AND st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
        AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
        AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes rcc 
        ON st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
        AND rcc.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_currency_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model_portfolio ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    ) spif
        ON spif.model_portfolio = st.model_portfolio_id
        AND spif.rn = 1
)
SELECT *
FROM JoinedData
WHERE rn = 1
AND transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active') AS "transactions_base"

/* QuickSight 4b24535c-b05a-4608-b7f8-b0df2d183f53 */
SELECT "business_date", "pool_name", "account_name", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "external_reporting_dm_em", "external_reporting_region", "external_reporting_country", "external_reporting_assetmix", "business_date_string", "year_month", "is_month_end", "is_fiscalyear_end", "external_reporting_dm_em_region", "external_reporting_currency", "total_market_value_pc"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'

SELECT "business_date", "pool_name", "account_name", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "external_reporting_dm_em", "external_reporting_region", "external_reporting_country", "external_reporting_assetmix", "business_date_string", "year_month", "is_month_end", "is_fiscalyear_end", "external_reporting_dm_em_region", "external_reporting_currency", "total_market_value_pc"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1

					business_date
			) dates

				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates

					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'

		, case

			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'

			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)
select * from lt_final_agg) AS "finsights_holdings_lookthrough"

/* cppi::3cc7870c086365b591f60d7ca894c3c1d681f2078cd2ddaa38399a04752f8fbe */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND (
			(day = 18 AND hour >= 23)
			OR (day = 19 AND hour <= 00)
		)

	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-18 23:06:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::ce2add19ab3f7321a3570dfa6e3baaa86ff6756ae1e44e9b40c2d0ae22cd51f3 */
WITH analytic_pv AS
    (select sd.business_date, analytic_value
     from radar_reporting_dev
    .fact_analytic_sd sd
    join radar_reporting_dev.dim_hierarchy_node dh
on sd.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dh.dim_hierarchy_node_id and dh.node_level=2 and dh.node_name ='BCPP'
    and sd.business_date = dh.business_date
where analytic_type = 'PV'
  and portfolio_type = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
  and sd.business_date = '2025-06-16'
    )
select ule.gics_sector,
       sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure)                                      as credit_exposure,
       pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit) as conc_sector_limit,
       case
           when max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit) > 0 then round(sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) /
                                                                     (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) *
                                                                     100, 2)
           else 0 end as usage,
    CASE
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.949999999
            THEN 'Yellow Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.999999999
            THEN 'Orange Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) >= (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit))
            THEN 'Breach'
        ELSE 'OK'
END
AS status

from radar_reporting_dev.fact_cr_exposure f
         join radar_reporting_dev.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity le on f.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = le.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and f.business_date = le.business_date
         join radar_reporting_dev.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity ule on le.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = ule.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and ule.gics_sector='Financials' and f.business_date = ule.business_date
         --and ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit is not null
		 -- and ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit != -1

         left join analytic_pv pv on f.business_date = pv.business_date
where f.bcpp_credit_exposure is not null
  and f.business_date = '2025-06-16'
group by ule.gics_sector, pv.analytic_value
order by sum(bcpp_credit_exposure) desc
